segments.t: Once every last order has been plated, Lyova, Senya, and Fedya stroll back into the kitchen expecting to find Aleksandr in ruins. Seeing right through their excuses, Aleksandr strips Lyova of his rank on the spot, promotes Max to sous-chef, and invites everyone to celebrate after work.
Ага, а у него реально пальцев нет.
Да ладно, не парься, по ходу разберёшься.
И вообще, приказы начальства не обсуждаются.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.
'Lyova, where were you?' Asking where Barinov was is how Max puts Barinov on the spot.
'And where were the rest of you?' Here asking where the rest of Max were shows Barinov looking for the real truth. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.

'My stomach really started hurting.' Since her stomach really started hurting, Vika does not waste words on excuses. In Russian you say "by me" or "with us" rather than "I have", so the situation sits right with the person.
Ага, а у него реально пальцев нет.
'Yeah, right, and his fingers are really missing.' Mentioning that yeah right and his fingers are really missing moves the talk in a new direction.
'Here is how it is going to be.' Saying that here is how it is going to be is how Barinov sets the tone with Max.

'You now have a new sous-chef.' Because Barinov now have a new, Vika treats the matter as settled. In Russian you say "by me" or "with us" rather than "I have", so the situation sits right with the person.
'What is your patronymic?' By asking what Barinov's patronymic is, Max presses Barinov for a straight answer.

'Is that clear to everyone?' Checking whether that clear to everyone cuts straight through the tension between Barinov and Max. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'I do not know about this.' Because she does not know about this, Vika treats the matter as settled.
Да ладно, не парься, по ходу разберёшься.
'Come on, do not sweat it, you will figure it out as you go.' Coming on do not sweat it Barinov will figure it out as Barinov goes is how Max lays out the situation for Barinov.
И вообще, приказы начальства не обсуждаются.
'Besides, orders from management are not up for discussion.' Barinov explains that besides orders from management are not up for discussion, keeping his voice calm and direct.

'And we will celebrate your promotion right away.' Realizing that they will celebrate Barinov's promotion right away changes how Vika handles the situation. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
'I am inviting all of you.' Max mentions that he is inviting all of Barinov so Barinov sees what is at stake. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.
Ага, а у него реально пальцев нет.
Да ладно, не парься, по ходу разберёшься.
И вообще, приказы начальства не обсуждаются.
That wraps up this scene as when Lyova, Senya, and Fedya stroll back into the kitchen after the rush, Aleksandr punishes Lyova by demoting him and naming Max the new sous-chef. See you next time!
